CustomField.description: 21 Sep 2026 (Kam, after Charlie Murray / VARO Partners): the words the Benefiting Group sentence uses when the group is described only by its type. Benefitting Group Type first - Corporate means the in-house legal function - then the Law.com BG Group field Law.com reps fill on the segmented line, where any value prints "organisation": a Law.com customer buys for the whole company as often as for its legal team, so the wider wording is the safe default and a rep who means a single team names it in Function Name.
CustomField.label: Order Form: group type words
